name: The Kuartz
shortDescription: New condominium at Karon Beach inspired by quartz facets and ocean curves.
description:
Two seven-storey residential buildings at Karon Beach, with architecture inspired by quartz facets and ocean curves.
The site is about 4,400 sqm with roughly 86 car parking spaces including EV spaces. Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.
